name: Nohmi Bosai Ltd.
summary: Nohmi Bosai Ltd. engages in the development, marketing, installation, and maintenance of various fire protection systems in Japan. The company operates through Fire Alarm Equipment, Fire Extinguishing Equipment, and Maintenance and Inspection Services segment. It offers fire alarm systems, such as addressable systems, conventional systems, notification appliances, manual stations, IR3 flame detectors, aspirating smoke detector; engineered and package type nitrogen gas fire suppression systems; foam extinguishing systems; sprinkler systems, foam fire extinguishing systems, plant disaster prevention systems, and tunnel disaster prevention systems.
